card.name: Mixed bag: tach- and linking words
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle of 'tachycardia' (the 'ach' piece) and on 'conv' in 'convulsions'. Also fires on small linking words like 'of' or 'with' after a role or risk word, such as 'member of' or 'risk of'.

modes.label: Inside heart-rhythm and seizure words
modes.description: The 'ach' piece in tachycardia or tachyarrhythmia, and 'conv' before 'ulsions'.
